raw: “I’d send them to the public garden. I go there every week, so that’s the route I’d use. You head east from my home along Pine Road, then turn right onto Linden Street at the bakery. The bakery is the thing to look for when you’re making that turn. The garden’s at 62 Linden Street. East makes me think of the sky—I’m an amateur stargazer, so directions bring that to mind. But for getting there, it’s Pine Road, right at the bakery, and then 62 Linden.”
